results.description:
Twofer brings the best local deals straight to your phone — buy-one-get-one offers, free add-ons, and real discounts at the cafés, bakeries, restaurants, and shops right around you.

No coupons to clip. No printouts. Just tap Claim and show your QR at the counter.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Browse live deals near you, sorted by distance or ending soon.
2. Tap Claim on the one you want.
3. Show your QR code or claim code to the staff.
4. Enjoy — and watch your savings add up in your Wallet.

FIND DEALS YOU'LL ACTUALLY USE
- Live, local, and time-limited — see what's on right now nearby.
- Favorite your go-to spots and get alerted the moment they post a new deal.
- Filter by "For you," "Nearest," "Ending soon," or "New."
- Set your area with GPS or just a ZIP code — your call.

FOR LOCAL BUSINESSES
Twofer isn't just for shoppers. Owners can create an offer in minutes — write it yourself or let the built-in tools draft the copy and a matching poster for you. Set your claim limits, publish, and redeem right at the register by scanning the customer's code. Reach new regulars without discounting to the whole internet.

BUILT TO BE FAIR
- No ads cluttering your feed.
- We don't sell your data.
- Available in English, Spanish, and Korean.

Sign in with email and a password — that's it. Twofer is designed for ages 13+.

Questions? We usually reply the same day: support@twoferapp.com

Point your phone and explore what lies in that direction.

Sightlines combines your location and compass heading with a clear map cone to show likely address and road candidates nearby. Adjust the direction, distance, and cone width to explore your surroundings. Results include confidence information rather than claiming certainty.

NEARBY AND NIGHT MODE
Request a fresh cloud scan to resolve address and road candidates. Night Mode provides a low-light interface and direction reports you can copy or share. Successful results are saved on your device, so you can revisit them without another cloud scan.

OFFLINE WORLD LINE
Follow a great-circle or compass line toward cities, countries, oceans, mountains, and landmarks using the bundled geographic dataset. World Line remains available without a subscription.

SIGHTLINES PLUS
Try three successful cloud scans before subscribing. Sightlines Plus costs $19.99 per year in the United States and includes 100 fresh cloud scans per subscription year, shared between Nearby and Night Mode. Local pricing is shown before purchase. The allowance refreshes when your annual subscription renews; unused scans do not carry over. Failed or empty scans do not count. Saved history and offline World Line remain available after your subscription ends.

The annual subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal. Payment is charged to your Apple account. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Restore Purchases is available in Settings.

PRIVACY AND ACCURACY
Location is used while the app is in use, not tracked in the background. Saved reports remain on your device unless you share them. Delete individual scans, all history, or your guest account from the app.

Sightlines is for discovery, not emergency response or navigation. GPS, compass calibration, and map data affect accuracy. A candidate is not a confirmed source of a sound, light, or event.

A little bounce. A big rescue.

Guide your penguin’s ice board, launch a snowball, and break through the ice to bring a friend home. Penguin Bounce is an endless arcade rescue game set in a colorful arctic cove.

FRESH ROUTES EVERY RUN
Discover new ice formations, rescue pockets, and rock layouts each time you play.

WATCH THE WATER
Rising and falling tides change which rocks block your snowball. Time your shots as the route shifts.

KEEP THE RESCUE GOING
Take on faster snowballs, tougher ice, and moving rocks as you reach higher levels. Every three rescues restores a heart.

CHASE YOUR PERSONAL BEST
Build chains, score bank shots, earn stars, and keep your best score and rescue records on your device.

MAKE IT YOUR MOMENT
Pause whenever you need to, and switch sound effects and gentle haptics on or off. No account is needed to play.

Presented by Twofer. An optional card after a finished run lets you discover Twofer’s local-deals app.

Slide. Stop. Try again.

Send a cheerful penguin gliding across an icy floe and land as close to the center as you can. Penguin Slide: Arctic Glide is a three-shot shuffleboard game with simple touch controls and a little room for one more try.

FIND YOUR GLIDE
Touch the penguin, pull back to choose your power and angle, and let go. A gentle pull or a bold launch can make all the difference.

THREE SHOTS. ONE PERFECT SCORE.
Stop in the target rings for 25, 50, or 100 points. Put together three perfect stops for 300. Slide off the ice and that shot scores zero.

A FRESH CHALLENGE EVERY RUN
Target positions change each time you play. Learn the ice, adjust your aim, and find the angle on your final shot.

CHASE YOUR PERSONAL BEST
Your best score stays on your device. Replay a run, pause for a moment, and come back for another glide.

MAKE IT YOUR MOMENT
Enjoy colorful arctic scenery, optional sound effects and gentle haptics, and support for your device’s reduced-motion setting. Gameplay works offline and no account is needed.

Presented by Twofer. An optional card after a finished run lets you discover Twofer’s local-deals app.

Slide across the ice with a very important delivery: a full cup of coffee.

Swipe left and right to guide your penguin through three short deliveries. Dodge snowbanks and rough ice, reach each customer, and see how much coffee you can keep in the cup. Every sip delivered counts toward your score.

• Three deliveries with different obstacle layouts
• Simple swipe controls: one swipe, one lane
• A perfect-run target of 300 points
• Personal best and completed results saved on your device
• Sound effects and optional haptics
• Offline gameplay with no account required

Play again to improve your best delivery run. Penguin Express is presented by Twofer.

The gulls stole your lunch. Time to launch the crew.

Penguin Crash: Ice Heist is a playful physics-puzzle adventure across 30 handcrafted levels. Pull back, aim, and send your penguins crashing through ice, timber, and precarious fortresses to recover every fish stash.

THREE PENGUINS, THREE TRICKS
Give Skipper a midair hop, bring Chonk down with a powerful slam, or time Puff’s bounce to turn an awkward landing into a brilliant shot.

A WHOLE ARCTIC HEIST
Explore Slippery Shores, Crooked Docks, and Freezer Fortress. Find weak supports, set off chain reactions, and work with rolling snowballs and hinged docks.

MASTER EVERY LEVEL
Earn completion, par, and gold medals in a single attempt. Replay your favorite puzzles and improve your personal bests.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
The complete game works offline. Pause whenever you need to, retry instantly, and adjust music, sound effects, haptics, and reduced motion. Progress and settings stay on your device.

No accounts or in-app purchases. Presented by Twofer, with an optional link after successful levels to discover the separate Twofer app.
